messages:
olga: Heads-up — opened an SDK PR that depends on an API change and a small helm chart bump. Need a short coordinated merge plan so runtime routing doesn't break. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1789, https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/2012, https://github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/312
prashant: What's the recommended merge order here? API first, then SDK, then helm?
aj: I'd prefer API -> helm -> SDK. Helm can do a canary so runtime routes to the new image only after the API shape is ready. Avoids 502s.
maria: @olga does the API PR include any DB migrations or long-running jobs?
olga: No schema changes. It's a response field rename + added v2 header. Backwards compatible, but we should bump the API contract version so SDK can opt in.
tom: I can review/approve API once CI is green. There is a flaky runtime integration test that occasionally times out for longer sequences — might block integration CI.
ci-bot: api PR #2012 — CI status: unit ✅ integration ❌ — failure: timeout on runtime-integration (log snippet: `ERROR: test_integration_timeout after 600s`)
aj: I'll take a look at that integration failure; looks like a KV cache path hit causing a stall. Trying to repro locally.
aj: Repro steps for me: `make test-integration RUNTIME=local SEQ=2048` — clearing the KV cache fixed the hang in my env. I pushed a small runtime hotfix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/999
devops-bot: Canary window scheduled by infra: 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC for helm chart change. Final helm PR needs sign-off by 01:30 UTC to be included.
prashant: Who's taking the helm chart update? I can do it but need the SDK image tag — @olga can you publish a canary image tag like `sdk-v1.12.0-canary-20260330`?
olga: Build pushed: `gcr.io/redwood/sdk:sdk-v1.12.0-canary-20260330`
maria: @aj once the runtime hotfix is merged I'll re-run API integration CI.
aj: Hotfix merged and pushed to staging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/999 — re-ran integration locally and it passed.
ci-bot: api PR #2012 — CI status: unit ✅ integration ✅
tom: Approved API PR. Recommendation: merge in this order — api -> helm (canary) -> sdk. I'll monitor the canary metrics.
olga: Plan: I'll merge API now, then open a final helm PR with the canary image tag. Once the helm canary is healthy, I'll merge the SDK PR.
prashant: Ack. Leaving a review on the helm PR and will watch canary logs.
maria: Ping me if we need to rollback the chart, I can revert quickly.
olga: Merged API at 1813456950. Will post back when helm canary starts and we have metrics. Thanks all!
